simple.meaning: קְנִזִּי (Qᵉnizzîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Kenizzite or descendant of Kenaz.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קְנִזִּי (H7074) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 15:19, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers, Joshua.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְנִזִּי (H7074) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קְנִזִּי (H7074) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קְנִזִּי (Qᵉnizzîy) / H7074 is traced through Genesis 15:19, Numbers 32:12, Joshua 14:6, Joshua 14:14 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
